root_cause: Wails parses JSON null into a nil interface for App.Query body any, then reflect.ValueOf(nil) panics before the method runs. Dispatcher returns no callback and UI read promises remain pending.
fix: Concrete map body at native boundary with explicit nil normalization to GET
20-second read callback timeout releases loading and permits retry; no mutation replay
Actual Wails binding tests required during build and source-hash-gated packaging
management_route: direct; no HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY or system proxy lookup
previous_gap: Headless acceptance bypassed Wails reflection; JavaScript runtime tests simulated native callbacks. New actual native dispatcher regression closes this gap.
